summary: Frontend-only verification of the MME Private Limited header logo update. Desktop logo wrapper is transparent, the inverted icon is visibly rendered in white, the exact bold wordmark 'MME Private Limited' is visible, and the mobile menu preserves the same treatment.
action_items: Backend API probe at http://localhost:8001/api/ was unavailable (connection refused); no backend lane was required because all acceptance criteria are UI-only.

checks.criterion: Header logo icon has no visible white tile/background and matches the dark header theme
checks.name: desktop-header-logo-transparent
checks.evidence: HTTP localhost:3010 home page rendered; [data-testid=header-logo-image] visible with non-zero bounds and opacity 1; [data-testid=header-logo-mark] computed background rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); screenshot captured desktop-logo.

checks.criterion: Desktop wordmark shows the full company name with Private Limited as bold and visible as MME
checks.name: desktop-wordmark-exact-bold
checks.evidence: [data-testid=header-logo-wordmark] text exactly 'MME Private Limited', computed color rgb(255, 255, 255), font weight 900, and visible non-zero bounds; screenshot captured desktop-wordmark.

checks.criterion: Mobile menu preserves the updated logo treatment
checks.name: mobile-menu-logo-treatment
checks.evidence: At 390x844, clicking [data-testid=mobile-menu-open-button] opened the menu; mobile icon had non-zero bounds and opacity 1, wrapper background was transparent, and wordmark exactly 'MME Private Limited' with white weight 900; screenshot captured mobile-logo-open.
